description: Uploading voice messages fails with 'Failed to upload voice message'. Diagnose and fix both frontend and backend integration issues for audio recording, uploading, and storing in TruckConnect.

storage: Local or S3-compatible storage for audio files

problems_identified.title: MediaRecorder incompatibility
problems_identified.details: Mobile devices may not support the current MediaRecorder implementation or MIME type, causing empty/invalid blobs.

problems_identified.title: Frontend upload errors
problems_identified.details: The RecordButton component may not convert the audio blob to FormData correctly, or headers/content-type are misconfigured.

problems_identified.title: Backend validation failure
problems_identified.details: The /api/upload/audio route may be rejecting multipart/form-data, or Zod validation for audioUrl/receiverId fails.

problems_identified.title: Race conditions with resolving tag to UUID
problems_identified.details: If the API accepts { tag, audioUrl, durationSeconds }, the server may not resolve the tag correctly before validating VoiceMessageSchema.

expected_behavior: User can record audio on desktop and mobile
Audio uploads successfully to backend storage
POST /api/voice-messages accepts { receiverId or tag, audioUrl, durationSeconds }
Voice message appears in inbox and triggers real-time notifications

requirements: Set appropriate MIME type for audio/webm or audio/mp4
Ensure blob is correctly created and not empty
Create FormData correctly: append('file', audioBlob, filename)
Handle async upload promise errors and display meaningful messages
Save file to storage and return absolute audioUrl
Return proper HTTP error code if upload fails
Resolve { tag } to UUID before Zod validation
Ensure receiverId exists in users table
Log audio blob size and MIME type
Log backend storage response and audioUrl

steps: Record audio on desktop and mobile
Upload audio and check network tab for 200 response
Verify audio is stored and audioUrl is returned
Send voice message to another user and check inbox
